modules.name: Application Shell
modules.description: Routing, layout, navigation, theme and global providers.
aiNotes: Preserve HashRouter compatibility for GitHub Pages.

modules.name: Dashboard
modules.description: Central daily interface and weekly overview.
aiNotes: Dashboard edits the same WorkDay records as the Work module.

modules.name: Work
modules.description: Work weeks, daily records, earnings, goals, tables and experimental intelligence.
aiNotes: WorkDay is the source of truth for daily work values.

modules.name: Settings
aiNotes: Components must use appSettingsService/useAppSettings instead of direct Dexie reads for preferences.

modules.name: Cloud Sync
modules.description: Private Supabase snapshot synchronization and conflict protection.
aiNotes: Never silently overwrite a detected two-sided conflict.

modules.name: Local Database
modules.description: Dexie/IndexedDB schema, migrations and local-first persistence.
aiNotes: Schema changes require explicit migrations and backup compatibility review.

modules.name: Portfolio
modules.description: Income and expense ledger, balances, tags, statistics and CSV import.
aiNotes: Portfolio balance is derived from the initial balance and chronologically ordered transactions.
Transactions store positive amounts; type determines the signed ledger value.
